venues.notes: Already crawled; added only the missing 2026-11-27 booking. Solo acts left out.

venues.name: Tonewood Brewing Oaklyn

venues.name: Village Idiot Brewing
venues.notes: Already in the dataset. The site has no events page (/events returns 404), so there are no new dates. Wayback was unreachable.

venues.name: Lower Forge Brewery
venues.notes: Meetup page says live bands and solo acoustic acts play nearly every weekend, plus open mics. The site has no calendar; it points to Instagram/Facebook.

venues.name: Double Nickel Brewing
venues.notes: Found no live music calendar; guessed domains don't resolve. Has a large event space. Its Medford taproom (lead) wasn't confirmed.

venues.name: Human Village Brewing
venues.notes: Took over the old Bus Stop Music Cafe; the music (open mics, shows) was run separately by Fran Corazo. No current listings found.

venues.name: Bonesaw Brewing
venues.notes: The events page embeds a Google Calendar that WebFetch can't read. There is also a Deptford Pilot House at Deptford Mall. Street address not confirmed.

venues.name: Broadway Theatre of Pitman
venues.notes: Musicals and comedy plus regional tribute bands. Recorded tribute and other band concerts only; musicals, comedians and solo acts left out. 2027 dates are outside the window.

venues.name: Wiggins Park (Camden County Sunset Jazz Series)
venues.notes: Free county series on the Camden waterfront: mostly national jazz, funk and R&B acts plus the July 4th Freedom Festival. Solo headliners left out; XPoNential Festival is listed separately (no lineup given).

venues.name: Haddon Lake Park Sundown Music Series
venues.address: McLaughlin-Norcross Memorial Dell, Haddon Lake Park, Haddon Heights, NJ 08035
venues.notes: Free county Wednesday series on the Haddon Heights/Audubon line: indie, rock and tribute headliners with local openers. Solo openers left out.

venues.name: Cooper River Park Twilight Concert Series
venues.address: Jack Curtis Stadium, Cooper River Park, North Park Drive, Pennsauken, NJ 08109
venues.notes: Free county Thursday series near Collingswood/Cherry Hill. Solo, orchestra and luau nights left out.

venues.name: Lindenwold Park
venues.notes: Camden County Friday shows with regional bar and tribute bands. Just outside the listed towns (next to Voorhees). The 2025 dates weren't found.

venues.name: Burlington County Amphitheater
venues.notes: Free county summer series of tribute and cover bands (6 pm opener, 7 pm headliner), next to Mount Holly. The 2025 announcement didn't say where each show was held; dates not marked for Smithville are assigned here. 2025 openers weren't named; solo openers left out of 2026.

venues.name: Historic Smithville Park
venues.notes: Opening and closing nights of the Burlington County summer series.

venues.name: Evesham Free Indoor Summer Concerts (Gibson House Community Center)
venues.notes: Township series on Mondays, 7-8 pm, July 6 to Aug 31, 2026. The lineup page returned 403.

venues.name: Collingswood May Fair
venues.notes: Street fair with several stages. The 2025 bill comes from a Bandsintown snippet; solo acts (Tara Hendricks, Camille K) left out. No 2026 lineup found.

venues.name: Jazz in the Wood (Collingswood Community Center)
venues.notes: Jazz Bridge neighborhood concerts on First Thursdays. One listing (Jon Katz group, Feb 6) was found but its year couldn't be confirmed, so no row. Address is from the community center, not this listing.

venues.name: Haddonfield Fall Festival
venues.address: Kings Highway and Tanner Street, Haddonfield, NJ 08033
venues.notes: 2026 music was community ensembles (Haddonfield Pick-Up Band, Golden Kazoo Band, ChildrenSong, a barbershop quartet), so no rows.

venues.name: Haddonfield July 4th Block Party
venues.notes: Main Stage on Kings Highway. The page lists 'Born to Run, Down to Dream' but gives no year, so no row (the band is already in the data at Tonewood).

venues.name: Burlington Riverfront Promenade (Cruzin on the River)
venues.notes: Monthly summer car-and-motorcycle cruise nights with concerts (2025-06-19, 07-17, 08-21, 09-18; 2026-08-20, 09-17). The city calendar names no bands.

venues.name: H.T. Costello Lyceum Hall
venues.notes: City-run hall: tribute concerts, brunch concerts, musicals. 'End of The Innocence – A Live Concert Tribute' (2025-06-14) names no act, so no row.

venues.name: Victor's Pub

venues.notes: Yearly beer fest with one band.

notes: The Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) was unreachable from this environment (both WebFetch and curl blocked), so there are no archived calendars. Bandsintown, allevents, jazznearyou, undiscovered.music, newjerseystage article pages and the Sun Papers mostly returned 403. Search quality for small South Jersey bars was poor: The Pour House (Westmont), Kettle & Kitchen, Bird & Bottle (Marlton), The Battery (Camden), Wenonah, Riverton Porchfest, Palmyra Cove events, Medford Freedom Park, Eastern Shore and Hidden Sands couldn't be confirmed as band venues in 2025-26 (Hidden Sands is in Egg Harbor Twp, outside the area). Most new rows come from free county park series (Camden County Summer Parks: Wiggins Park, Haddon Lake Park, Cooper River Park, Lindenwold Park; Burlington County Amphitheater/Smithville) and the Broadway Theatre of Pitman. Several park-series acts are national touring bands; they're recorded because the series also books regional and tribute acts. Solo headliners and openers were left out. In 2025, Burlington County only gave locations for June 20 and Aug 23 (Smithville), so the other dates are assigned to the Amphitheater. Pitman's Oct 2025 tribute dates come from a NJArts calendar snippet (the page itself 404s). ALREADY venues weren't re-crawled except Tonewood (2 dates added) and Village Idiot (no calendar). Scottish Rite 2026 shows found (The Rascals, Patty Griffin, Hot Tuna, Chris Botti) are national, so they're left out per 'locals only'.
